Which companies produce rare earths and nickel in Russia?
Thought for 1s

The table has 1 row, for “Rare earths”. Operators, as printed: OAO Apatit. The table has 3 rows, all for “Ore, Ni content”. Operators, as printed: OAO Ufaleynickel, PAO GMK Norilskiy Nickel (Nornickel) and ZAO NPK Geotechnologiya.

The companies that produce rare-earths and nickel in Russia are listed in the USGS Minerals Yearbook for 2022 (source).

Rare-earths (2022) Location: Mines at Lovozerskoye deposit, Kola Peninsula (USGS Minerals Yearbook, volume III (Area Reports: International), country chapters). Capacity: 2700 metric tons (source). See the table below

Nickel (2022) See the table below

Rare earths facilities in Russia — USGS Minerals Yearbook 2022
Operator	Location	Capacity, as printed
OAO Apatit	Mines at Lovozerskoye deposit, Kola Peninsula	2700 metric tons

Every cell is copied from the USGS table as printed. Capacity is capacity, not production. The table names no buyers. USGS Minerals Yearbook, volume III (Area Reports: International), country chapters, Table 2. Structure of the mineral industry (Table 2) ↗
